descriptions.normal: Classic convenience food. Put a sausage in some bread, sprinkle on some fried onions, a generous squirt of sauce... and there you go, a delicious, filling Nod-Krai Hot Dog!
descriptions.suspicious: Classic convenience food. The sausage is too dry, while the bread is too soft, giving the unpleasant impression of chewing on a sponge... If not for hunger, it would be hard not to throw it away...
descriptions.delicious: Classic convenience food. Freshly cooked sausage paired with freshly baked bread. With each bite, the irresistible aroma of fat fills the palate. It's gone in a few quick bites, leaving you craving another.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 9% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 12% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
